objective: Find whether KR names that are cheap against their own sector AND whose point-in-time accounts confirm the business (net income, operating cash flow and its improvement all positive) earn a higher net return than 069500.KS over 6-12 months, and whether the confirmation is what pays, measured only on signals recorded at the close they describe.
registrationStatement: Pre-registered before any signal of this study exists. Merging the change that adds this file is the authorization: the first eligible signal is the first KR weekly decision session strictly after the KST date of that merge and not before firstEligibleSignalSessionFloor.
Every rule, input, horizon, cost, metric and threshold below is fixed here. A changed rule is a new study version with its own ledger; this one is never edited, rescored or restarted.
No result exists. Until the registered checks run, nothing may be described as predictive, and no book enters the official weekly decision, an order or a production weight.
historicalEvidenceStatement: The rule is kr_alpha_signal_v2's H2 (within-industry value with three confirmation signs at zero, no fitted parameter); the closed kr-alpha-atlas programme measured the same accounting family (X1) on the historical sample, Phase D nominated nothing, and that sample is not re-read.

What is new is the information in a LIVE record: the production build ranks on a Yahoo current snapshot and has never used point-in-time DART accounting. This study records it prospectively, beside kr-selection-challenger-v1's price-only books.

hypotheses.CH_VALUE_CONFIRMED: A stock cheap against its own sector out-earns 069500.KS when the business behind the price is profitable, cash-backed and not deteriorating; a cheap stock without that confirmation is more often a value trap.

CTRL_CHEAP_UNCONFIRMED.purpose: the same cheapness without confirmation: tests whether the confirmation is what pays

signalRule.implementation: pipeline.kr_alpha_signal_v2.cross_section (design digest recorded on every receipt)
signalRule.cheap: mean within-sector percentile of the two value fields >= 2/3
signalRule.readiness: value and confirmation each measured on >= 60% of their denominators, else every book holds 069500.KS only (BLOCKED_COVERAGE)

inputs.accounting: <signal-history>/ledger/fundamentals/kr-canonical-v2 dart-*.jsonl.gz filings, visible strictly before the signal date (alpha_opportunity_features.visible_filings: availableFrom < signal date and the receipt number dated that day), derived by kr_value_quality_catalyst.accounting_values (TTM rollforward, one statement basis, book = assets - liabilities)
inputs.accountingStoreChoice: kr-canonical-v2, not the daily kr store: on 2026-10-16 the kr store yields net income TTM for 24 of 119 production KR names (exact-label defect, v2.33) against 115 for the canonical store. The canonical store is rebuilt only by the fundamentals workflow's manual raw-statements target, so its freshness is recorded on every receipt (accountingStore.newestAvailableFrom) and stale accounts stay point-in-time correct, never forward-filled
inputs.marketCap: production validationCrossSection marketCap (Yahoo snapshot at the build, a stated proxy for the KRX issue cap)
inputs.industry: production sector (Yahoo), a stated proxy for the registered KRX industry; fewer than 5 eligible names in a sector makes them INELIGIBLE, never ranked against the market
inputs.preferredShares: a six-digit code not ending in 0 is a preferred class and INELIGIBLE (stated heuristic; unknown is never assumed common)
inputs.liquidity: vendor daily bars (datafeed.fetch_prices) aligned to the KRX calendar by kr_bar_integrity: traded on all 20 latest sessions and median close x volume over the latest 60 sessions >= 1,000,000,000 KRW (kr_alpha_signal_v2 constants); a missing, suspended or invalid session is not traded; traded value is the close AS TRADED (fetch_prices auto_adjust=False: split-consistent, not dividend-adjusted) x volume, so a split cancels in the product and no dividend factor scales earlier sessions
inputs.downloadFailure: a name counts as collected only if the vendor delivered its signal-session row; if fewer than half of the names are collected, no receipt is written and a later run in the same window retries. Missing sessions are never interpolated

schedule.signalSessions: KR weekly decision sessions: a KR session whose next KR session falls in a later ISO week (prospective_receipt_core.is_weekly_decision_session)
schedule.artifactRule: the artifact's ^KS11 session equals the last KR session that was final (18:00 KST) at the artifact's generatedAt
schedule.receiptWindow: created by the writer's own clock after 18:00 KST of the signal session and before 09:00 KST of the next KR session (prospective_receipt_core.check_timing); as kr-selection-challenger-v1, the window is checked when the run starts and again after every download, createdAtUtc is the clock at the write (pipeline.kr_selection_challenger.append_live_receipt) and a window that closes during recording is RECEIPT_WINDOW_CLOSED_DURING_RECORDING (REFUSED, nothing appended)
schedule.execution: close of the next KR session after the signal session (session 0)
schedule.runner: scripts/update_ledger.py (the paper-ledger step of .github/workflows/ledger.yml) calls scripts/record_kr_selection_challenger_v2.run_all after v1's recorder; any refusal is caught and never costs the paper ledger. No workflow file is changed.
schedule.expectedCadence: The 00:10 UTC cron starts about 04:30 UTC, inside the KRX session on weekdays, so weekday runs skip (ARTIFACT_NOT_BUILT_ON_A_FINAL_SESSION) and the Saturday run records Friday's session; Sunday's run is the backup inside the same window.

outcomeDefinition.priceBasis: vendor adjusted close (pipeline.datafeed.fetch_prices, auto_adjust) for every name and for 069500.KS, from one download at grading time, aligned to the pinned KRX calendar by pipeline.kr_bar_integrity
outcomeDefinition.nameReturn: close at the maturity session (horizon sessions after execution) / close at the execution session - 1
outcomeDefinition.notExecutable: a name SUSPENDED (zero volume) at the execution session cannot be bought; its slot is held in 069500.KS
outcomeDefinition.unresolved: a name with no vendor frame, no row or an invalid close at execution, or that did not trade on the maturity session itself, makes that book's cohort outcome None (NAME_OUTCOME_MISSING or TERMINAL_ECONOMICS_UNRESOLVED); it is never marked at an earlier close, dropped or renormalised
outcomeDefinition.netExcess: book return - 069500.KS return - stock legs (buy at execution, sell at maturity) - ETF legs of benchmark-held slots + the ETF control's own round trip
outcomeDefinition.costs: pipeline.weekly_decision.trade_cost_fraction('KR', date, ...): commission + half spread per leg, dated statutory sell tax on stock sells, no tax on ETF sells (benchmark_alpha.REALISTIC_COSTS)
outcomeDefinition.retry: as kr-selection-challenger-v1 (pipeline.kr_selection_challenger.resolution, called, not copied): a PROVIDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE gap (benchmark unpriced, or a held name with no vendor frame, no row or an invalid close: an empty or partial download) is DEFERRED at any date, never written, regraded by every later run and kept in outcome-pending.json outside the ledgers; only an ECONOMIC_UNRESOLVED name (the served maturity session shows zero volume) is written as FINAL_UNRESOLVED_AFTER_RETRY once the (horizon + 5)-th KR session after execution is final, and counted as None. Closing a cohort the provider never serves is an owner decision

assessment.interim: No outcome statistic is published before a registered check. Turnover (a signal-time fact) is reported at any time.

harmCheck.rule: on the first 52 receipts, once all are graded at H126: STOPPED_HARM if the Newey-West 95% upper bound of mean net excess vs 069500.KS is below 0; INCONCLUSIVE_DATA if more than 5 outcomes are None

riskPath.navBasis: as kr-selection-challenger-v1 riskPath.navBasis (the same paper_path, called, not copied): risk is measured from the pre-trade NAV of 1.0, so the opening cost enters Sharpe and max drawdown once, as it does the annual return
riskPath.notExecutable: as kr-selection-challenger-v1 (pipeline.kr_selection_challenger.paper_path, called, not copied): a newly chosen name SUSPENDED (served row, zero volume) on a rebalance session is held as 069500.KS for that period, the same rule as the cohort outcome; a missing row or invalid close on a rebalance session, or a held name without a traded close on any marking day, makes the path INCOMPLETE

primary.rule: on the first 104 receipts, once all are graded at H252 and H126: SUPPORTED only if (1) the one-sided 97.5% Newey-West lower bound of mean H252 net excess vs 069500.KS is above 0, (2) the mean H126 net excess is above 0, (3) the mean H252 net excess vs CTRL_MODEL5 is above 0, (4) the mean H252 net excess vs CTRL_CHEAP_UNCONFIRMED is above 0, and (5) the 4-weekly rebalanced daily paper path has Sharpe >= 069500.KS and |max drawdown| <= 1.25 x 069500.KS over the same sessions; NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise; INCONCLUSIVE_DATA if more than 10 outcomes are None in ANY series a check reads (H252, H126, and the paired H252 comparisons with CTRL_MODEL5 and CTRL_CHEAP_UNCONFIRMED, each counted on its own valid pairs) or the risk path is incomplete or its Sharpe or drawdown is undefined

assessment.inference: kelly_portfolio._newey_west_stats on the receipt-dated series (Bartlett HAC, lag from the horizon in observations of this series); overlapping weekly cohorts are never counted as independent
assessment.afterVerdict: A SUPPORTED verdict is development evidence for one owner decision, never an automatic promotion. STOPPED_HARM or NOT_SUPPORTED closes this version; recording may continue for the record but no rule is changed to rescue it.

turnover: names replaced per weekly receipt and per path rebalance, as a share of five slots (weights retargeted are not turnover here)

scientificDependencies.contract: As kr-selection-challenger-v1. v2's rules run through v1's outcome, resolution, risk-path and interval code, the receipt core, kr_alpha_signal_v2 and the accounting derivation; those files are pinned by bytes (fileHashes). The production helpers v1 calls (pipeline.kr_selection_challenger.conformance_values) and the accounting derivation's behaviour on a fixed synthetic filing pair (kr_value_quality_catalyst.accounting_values at four dates, ratio, S2.MIN_MEDIAN_TRADED_VALUE_KRW) are pinned by behaviour (conformanceDigest, pipeline.kr_selection_challenger_v2.conformance_values). LIVE record, outcomes and assess refuse SCIENTIFIC_DEPENDENCY_CHANGED; a legitimate change to any of them, including a change to v1's own files, is a new study version, never a re-pin of this one. Outside the contract by design: the production artifact (CTRL_MODEL5) and weekly_publish.unsafe_reason
